column1: Rinse the rice in a bowl or strainer under cold water, swirling and draining, until the water runs clear.
Add the rice, water and salt to a pot. Use 2 cups water and 1/2 tsp salt for every 1 cup of rice.
Bring to a boil, then cover, lower the heat to a simmer and cook 18 minutes without lifting the lid.
Take off the heat and rest 5 minutes with the lid still on.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve.
